1. Introduction & Basic Symmetry.en: Phylum Porifera includes multi-cellular organisms with cellular grade of organization.
1. Introduction & Basic Symmetry.hi: संघ पोरिफेरा में कोशिकीय स्तर के संगठन वाले बहुकोशिकीय जीव शामिल हैं।

mcqQuiz.question: What is the basic unit of classification?
True or False: Sponges have bilateral symmetry.

importantQuestions.question: Explain the difference between Radial and Bilateral symmetry.
importantQuestions.answer: Radial symmetry means the animal can be divided into equal halves by any plane passing through the central axis. Bilateral symmetry means division into identical left and right halves in only one plane.

importantQuestions.question: Why are animals classified?
importantQuestions.answer: Classification helps in understanding the relationship among different groups of animals and makes their study easier.
